core_obligations: The complex and its maps (proof lines 3187-3223): X_n = g_{n!}K_n; Hom(X_n, X_{n-1}) = the direct sum of Hom(K_n, f_phi^{-1}K_{n-1}) because K_phi is invertible (assumption (1)), and the map X_n -> X_{n-1} is the alternating sum over the coface maps delta^n_0..delta^n_n; the compositions are zero (the author marks this routine check as omitted - auxiliary step, see notes).

Postnikov extension (lines 3224-3245): Hom(X_i[i-j-2], X_j) = Hom(K_i[i-j-2], g_i^{-1}g_{j!}K_j) vanishes for i > j+2 because cartesianness makes g_i^{-1}g_{j!}K_j a finite direct sum of copies of K_i and assumption (2) kills Hom(K_i[t], K_i) for t > 0; the Derived Categories Postnikov lemma then gives Y_0 = X_0 with sequences Y_n -> X_n -> Y_{n-1} -> Y_n[1], and K is set to hocolim Y_n[n].

The isomorphisms g_m^{-1}K = K_m (lines 3247-3310): g_m^{-1}Y_n[n] is a Postnikov system for g_m^{-1}X_n; the componentwise maps (direct sums of the K_phi) identify the complex g_m^{-1}X_* with the explicit complex (direct sums of Z)[-n] tensor^L K_m whose Postnikov towers Y'_{m,n} have homotopy colimit K_m (the key Postnikov example, compared with lemma-abelian-postnikov); the second part of the Postnikov lemma extends the vertical maps to isomorphisms gamma_{m,n} of Postnikov systems (the needed vanishing again from assumption (2)), and uniqueness of homotopy colimits assembles gamma_m : g_m^{-1}K -> K_m.

Compatibility with the simplicial system (lines 3312-3337): a three-row diagram chase proves f_phi^{-1}gamma_m followed by K_phi equals gamma_n after g_n^{-1}K - the top middle square commutes because X_0 -> K is a morphism of simplicial objects, the left and right rectangles because gamma_m and gamma_n are compatible with gamma_{0,m} and gamma_{0,n}, the outer rectangle because (K_n, K_phi) is a simplicial system and X_0(varphi) comes from the identifications f_phi^{-1}f_psi^{-1}K_0 = f_{phi psi}^{-1}K_0; since the arrow into Y'_{0,m} is an isomorphism on each direct summand, restricting to one summand (which maps isomorphically to f_phi^{-1}g_m^{-1}K as gamma_m is an isomorphism) yields the lower middle square.
proof_roadmap: Build the complex ... -> X_2 -> X_1 -> X_0 by alternating sums of the invertible maps K_phi^{-1}.
Extend it to a Postnikov system using the assumed vanishing of self-extensions; set K = hocolim Y_n[n].
Compare g_m^{-1} of the Postnikov system with the explicit Z-tensor-K_m towers to obtain g_m^{-1}K = K_m.
Chase the compatibility diagram to see the isomorphisms respect the simplicial-system maps K_phi.
